confidence_notes: Food estimates use crowd-sourced Mendoza prices updated in September–October 2026 as a proxy for July; sample sizes and Argentina’s rapid price changes limit precision. The cocktail estimate follows the local cocktail-to-draft-beer price relationship of about 1.8×; the wine glass estimate is near the draft-beer price. Accommodation is a holistic estimate, not based on live rates.
comparable_city_reasoning: Accommodation is estimated from mid-sized regional Argentine cities, with a modest premium for Mendoza’s wine tourism and visitor demand.
